instrument: SS-264 labeled top-5 precision set (10 queries)
scoring: P@5 = |top5 ∩ relevant| / min(5, |top5|); empty top5 scores 0; binary relevance; average over all queries must be >= 0.9 (4.5/5). Top-5 = first page of the API relevance order (score DESC, createdAt DESC, id DESC).
labelPolicy: v0 scores (ورتی 3/5, Anker 2/5) were human-labeled in the audit and are frozen forever; the relevant product identities were recovered from the live dev catalog on 2026-11-01. The 8 remaining queries were labeled 2026-11-01 by the documented relevance rule per query (approved by the user; review/edit this file in the PR). Rules are resolved against the live catalog by the instrument script; the CI-hermetic regression spec holds its own explicit fixture identities with the same rules.
relevantRuleShape: nameContains matches normalize_fa(Product.name); nameEnContains matches normalize_fa(Product.nameEn); auxContains matches normalize_fa(subtitle || ' ' || focusKeyword); brandName matches the product's live Brand.name exactly. Relevance standard: the query term appears in the product's operator-authored text or brand assignment.

Consequence accepted by the user 2026-11-01.
